title: Slight awkwardness and rougher ride impressions
summary: This topic groups comments about slight awkwardness in usability or entry, disappointment over a missing standing-outside parking function, and some rougher-ride impressions, with many fragments too vague to classify confidently.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention an awkward door pocket and disappointment that parking cannot be done while standing outside the car.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says the car is liked overall but its low height makes getting in and out slightly awkward.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention rougher roads, a rougher-than-expected ride, a smaller package, mixed step-up language, and slight apprehension, but the examples are too vague to classify confidently.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are short and ambiguous, so the topic contains substantial undetermined content.
The examples mix ride quality, cabin usability, vehicle height, parking-function expectations, and general impressions rather than one clearly unified subject.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of all reviews.
